// Demo-only: never send mail; no personal data leaves Playground.
add_filter('pre_wp_mail', static function () { return true; });
add_filter('show_admin_bar', '__return_false');

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// This fixture is not included in the plugin ZIP. All identities are synthetic.
update_option( 'blogname', 'Northside Bike Repair — Sample' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'An invented bicycle workshop. Synthetic sample data only.' );
update_option( 'nsb_settings', array(
    'services' => array( 'Safety check', 'Puncture repair', 'Brake service', 'Full tune-up' ),
    'notification_email' => 'workshop@example.invalid',
    'success_text' => 'Sample request received. This demo does not make a real booking.',
    'delete_data' => false,
) );
$page = get_page_by_path( 'book-a-repair' );
$page_id = wp_insert_post( array(
    'ID' => $page ? $page->ID : 0,
    'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => 'book-a-repair',
    'post_title' => 'Book a repair', 'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->[northside_booking]<!-- /wp:shortcode -->',
) );
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
$states = array( 'new', 'confirmed', 'done', 'cancelled' );
$services = array( 'Safety check', 'Puncture repair', 'Brake service', 'Full tune-up' );
for ( $i = 1; $i <= 8; ++$i ) {
    $slug = sprintf( 'northside-sample-%02d', $i );
    $found = get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'nsb_request', 'post_status' => array( 'private', 'trash' ), 'name' => $slug, 'posts_per_page' => 1 ) );
    wp_insert_post( array(
        'ID' => $found ? $found[0]->ID : 0,
        'post_type' => 'nsb_request', 'post_status' => 'private', 'post_name' => $slug,
        'post_title' => sprintf( 'Sample Rider %02d', $i ),
        'meta_input' => array(
            '_nsb_name' => sprintf( 'Sample Rider %02d', $i ),
            '_nsb_email' => sprintf( 'rider%02d@example.invalid', $i ),
            '_nsb_phone' => '', '_nsb_service' => $services[ ( $i - 1 ) % 4 ],
            '_nsb_date' => wp_date( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( '+' . ( 7 + $i ) . ' days' ) ),
            '_nsb_notes' => 'Synthetic sample request. No real person or appointment.',
            '_nsb_state' => $states[ ( $i - 1 ) % 4 ], '_nsb_mail_status' => 'sample',
        ),
    ) );
}
flush_rewrite_rules( false );
echo "Seed complete: eight synthetic requests; two per state.\n";
